## Up for adoption

Unfinished co-op projects whose authors have stopped working on them and would like someone to carry on. Pick one up, fork it, and open a claim issue so others know.

| Game | Project | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crimson Desert | [Crimson Desert Multiplayer (cdmp)](https://github.com/ByJunter/CrimsonDesertMultiplayer) (up for adoption) | alpha | ASI mod (Ultimate ASI Loader) for Steam build 1.0.0.2976 / game version 2.03.02 only; turns itself off on other builds. Each player stays in their own save and sees the other; hostile enemies near the host are shared (experimental); quests, NPCs and items are not shared; Steam friends only. GPL-3.0. The author stopped work at v0.2.0 and invites others to continue it. A revival focused on shared quest progress is claimed in cranebeaker/coop-anything#51: builds on Linux with clang-cl + xwin, one-PC echo smoke test ran under Proton (no automated two-player test yet). Research and dated notes in games/crimson-desert. |

## Open gaps

Loved single-player games where no co-op project was found. Searched sources are in the YAML. If you find one, replace the gap entry with a real one.

| Game | Year | Engine | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alan Wake 2 and Control | 2023 | Northlight | Alan Wake 2 has a mod loader and modding docs on GitHub but no multiplayer mod; I found nothing for Control. Remedy's FBC Firebreak is an official co-op game in the Control universe. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Assassin's Creed Origins, Odyssey and Valhalla | 2017 | AnvilNext | No campaign co-op mod found for any recent entry; Unity has official side-mission co-op with a chat-fix mod, and Brotherhood and Revelations only have multiplayer NPC overhauls. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Atomic Heart | 2023 | Unreal Engine 4 | Only single-player trainers and an internal mod menu exist; the developer dropped multiplayer. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 | 2011 | IW 5.0 (Call of Duty) | No campaign co-op has released for Modern Warfare 3 (2011) on any platform, and no project ships it; the singleplayer engine carries no netcode. Spec Ops/Survival co-op does exist (official, and via the AlterWare client). A from-zero attempt is written up in games/modern-warfare-3. |
| Command & Conquer 3 Kane's Wrath | 2008 | SAGE (C&C3 era) | No campaign co-op found. Same engine seams as Tiberium Wars (lobby side stripping, Steam/LAN netcode), so the Tiberium Wars prototype should port; see games/command-and-conquer-3. |
| Dead Space | 2008 | Visceral Engine | No co-op mod for Dead Space 1 on PC found. Visceral cut co-op during development; a Steam Workshop Dead Space CO-OP Edition is a Garry's Mod collection, not a mod for the game. |
| Dead Space (2023 remake) | 2023 | Frostbite | Only Dead Space 2 competitive multiplayer revival and Garry's Mod co-op maps turned up; nothing for the remake. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Death Stranding | 2020 | Decima | PC release year shown; only a Director's Cut mod loader exists (NRTnarathip/DeathStrandingModLoader) with no multiplayer features. Game already has asynchronous shared structures. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Freedom Fighters | 2003 | Zero (IOI engine) | No playable co-op mod. A reverse-engineering repo (jackedhawk-117/freedom-fighters-re) reports the PC exe still has multiplayer code but re-enabling the lobby alone gives no playable match. |
| Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut | 2024 | Sucker Punch proprietary | PC release year shown; Nexus and ModDB list single-player mods only. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Ghostrunner | 2020 | Unreal Engine 4 | No co-op or multiplayer mod found for Ghostrunner or Ghostrunner 2 on any platform. The GOG build is Unreal Engine 4.26; engine networking and runtime hook findings are written up in games/ghostrunner. |
| God of War (2018) | 2022 | Santa Monica Studio proprietary | PC release year shown; no co-op or multiplayer mod found, only trainers, cosmetic mods and an Atreus companion AI tweak. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Hitman: Blood Money | 2006 | Glacier | No playable co-op mod found for the older Hitman games. A Steam guide mentions a ReHitman reverse-engineering effort aiming for multiplayer, with no release seen. Hitman 3 has unrelated Nexus co-op mods. |
| Horizon Zero Dawn | 2020 | Decima | PC release year shown; Nexus and ModDB list only single-player mods, and the Remastered Steam thread has players asking for co-op. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Mass Effect / Mass Effect 2 | 2007 | Unreal Engine 3 | No co-op campaign mod found for ME1 or ME2. Players have only requested it for the Legendary Edition. ME3 has an official horde co-op, a Nexus proof-of-concept campaign co-op for ME3, and LEMP brings ME3-style multiplayer to the Legendary Edition. |
| Mass Effect Legendary Edition | 2021 | Unreal Engine 3 | No campaign co-op released; Nexus forum threads only request it, and an ME3 proof-of-concept co-op mission mod was abandoned by its author. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Max Payne | 2001 | MaxFX | No working co-op or multiplayer mod found for the first Max Payne. Max Payne 3 has official co-op. A Steam Workshop item named max payne coop was seen but not opened. |
| Metro 2033 | 2010 | 4A Engine | No co-op campaign mod found. Metro: Terminus (a Call to Arms conversion) was archived, Metro 2033 H Hour is described as dead, and a Redux Extended World pack mentions a multiplayer mod without detail. |
| Metro Exodus | 2019 | 4A Engine | No co-op mod found; Steam threads just ask for it. 4A released an official Exodus SDK with mod.io support, so a mod is technically possible. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Middle-earth: Shadow of War | 2017 | Firebird (LithTech derivative) | No co-op or multiplayer mod found; the game's online features (Vendettas, Online Conquest) are asynchronous only. JustAddMP/ShadowOfWar is a placeholder repo ("planned", README only, 2026-10-17). Research and reverse-engineering notes for Steam build 3095001 (test-copy isolation, debug-print capture, Nemesis event, death, promotion and RNG functions with signatures) are in games/shadow-of-war; claim issue cranebeaker/coop-anything#93. |
| Prey (2006) | 2006 | id Tech 4 | No co-op campaign mod found. The Prey 2006: A Talon Brave Game port restores competitive multiplayer only. The co-op mod that exists is for the 2017 Prey. |
| Psychonauts | 2005 | Despair Engine / Gamebryo | No co-op or multiplayer mod found; results were texture packs, fixes and an Archipelago randomizer integration. |
| Resident Evil Requiem | 2026 | RE Engine | No official co-op and no released co-op mod. Two creators are showing an unreleased co-op mod on YouTube (name, download and source unknown); check it before starting from zero. REFramework loads on the game, so the RE2 and RE4 (2023) co-op mod tooling applies. Reddit not checked. |
| Resident Evil Village | 2021 | RE Engine | No campaign co-op mod found; only the official Re:Verse mode exists. REFramework tooling that powered the RE2 and RE4 mods applies, so it is a feasible gap. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Risen | 2009 | Genome | No co-op or multiplayer mod found for Risen; results only showed unofficial patches and single-player mods. |
| Silent Hill 2 | 2001 | Proprietary (Konami) | No co-op mod found for the 2001 original. The co-op work seen targets Silent Hill 1 (Silent Hill: United) and the 2024 remake (GhostCoop). |
| Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition | 2014 | unknown | A 2024 Nexus comment says modder sneakyevil has long been working on an MP mod that stalled; a widely shared video is warned about as a survey scam. Treat as unconfirmed. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order and Survivor | 2019 | Unreal Engine 4 | Only single-player mods and a discontinued blueprint mod loader (FallenOrderModLoader) turned up. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| The Godfather II | 2009 | Visceral Engine | No PC story-campaign co-op project surfaced; the restored match multiplayer and the SE script extender are not campaign co-op. Research on branch game/the-godfather-ii (claim issue |
| The Last of Us Part I | 2023 | Naughty Dog proprietary | PC release year shown; no PC co-op mod found. The Nexus and Steam videos titled first cooperative splitscreen mod 2025 appear to target the PS3 original and I could not verify them. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Thief: The Dark Project / Gold | 1998 | Dark Engine | No dedicated co-op mod for Thief 1 or Gold found. A Steam guide on Thief Gold multiplayer was seen but not opened, and Thief II has the T2 multiplayer project listed separately. |
| Titanfall 2 (campaign) | 2016 | Source (modified) | Steam threads say campaign co-op is not possible; one poster recalls an unnamed sponsor-only co-op campaign video. Northstar adds PvE hosting and the Icepick tool runs single-player mods, but neither is campaign co-op. Official Frontier Defense is horde mode. |
| Wolfenstein: The New Order and Wolfenstein II | 2014 | id Tech 5 | No co-op mod found for either game; the searches only surfaced unrelated Men of War and HOI4 mods named The New Order. RTCWCoop exists for the 2001 game only. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| World in Conflict (with Soviet Assault) | 2007 | Masstech (Massive Entertainment) | No campaign co-op mod found. The game ships LAN multiplayer, a dedicated server and AI bots, and single player runs on the same server code behind one flag; every original-campaign map is also an MP map. Research and design notes in games/world-in-conflict. |
